title: M1 ADRs 0001–0010
question: What has M1 already decided?
key_claims: 0001: TS host runtime + thin Python guest agent, NDJSON loopback
0002: independent read-only three-valued verifier (verified|refuted|uncertain); no eval of task strings
0003: uiautomation + raw comtypes timeouts; steal agent-desktop primitives, no dependency; escape hatch = aarch64 FFI artifact
0004: programs as data, closed action union + declarative predicates
0005: pluggable FaultInjector; ground truth computed host-side
0006: recovery = known-good stateVersion, idempotent resume, bounded retry, uncertain over guessing; no success without post-recovery verification
0007: evidence = trace.jsonl + result.json + conformance ledger; gap never counted as pass
0008: harness emits falseSuccesses audited vs host ground truth
0009: baseline Agent S3 + UI-TARS-1.5-7B identical conditions; no paid/hosted without escalation
0010: ratify docs/env/windows.md

title: Orgo Computers API: fork/clone/suspend lifecycle surface
question: Minimal host interface for create/snapshot/reset/fork?
key_claims: fork = disk+live memory copy; child running from same instant; source pauses ~2s; Linux+running only; NOT_FORKABLE error
clone = disk-only, fresh boot
suspend/resume = memory to/from storage; stop = archive disk (frozen)
create-from-template = golden-image reuse primitive

limitations: No technical blog post exists (orgo.ai/blog is a site summary); all evidence from API docs
Hosted paid service — concept source only, never a dependency (no-paid-accounts rule)
